children: India's Sensex rises 1.6%, led by financial and auto stocks. Mahindra & Mahindra rises 5.0%, ICICI Bank adds 4.1% and HDFC Bank is 2.7% higher. The benchmark index bucks the wider regional declines weighed by risk-off sentiment tied to AI. Regional equity plays that have been relatively less exposed to the AI-play this year appear to be benefiting in the initial phase of the re-allocation, such as India's equity markets, supported by a pickup in foreign interests this week, DBS economist Radhika Rao says. The inflow of capital strengthened the rupee, with the dollar last 0.5% lower at 94.01 rupees. A stable rupee has resulted in index gains in India in dollar terms, Rao adds. (kimberley.kao@wsj.com)
